description: Read a single sent email by id, to inspect its delivery, such as the SMTP response on a bounced send or the gate denial on a gate_denied one. Pass full: true for the stored record. Result: id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject, body_text and attachments; when set, scheduled_at, canceled_at, in_reply_to_email_id, cc, bcc, reply_to, tags and attachments_complete; when not delivered, error_code, error_message, gates, smtp_response_code and smtp_response_text; by default body_source and quoted_chars_removed; with full: from_address, to_address, request_id and body_html.

full.description: Return the stored record, with the HTML body and quoted history, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Sent email ID from listSentEmails or a /send-mail response.

name: getSentEmail

attachments.description: Files sent with it; read one with getEmailAttachment and source sent.

filename.description: File name; null when the email gave none.

part_index.description: Pass to getEmailAttachment to read it.

attachments_complete.description: False when some attachments may be missing from the list.

bcc.description: Blind-copied addresses, when there were any.

body_source.description: text, html or none: what body_text was made from. Not with full.

body_text.description: The body as text, quoted history left out unless full; null when there is none.

canceled_at.description: When a scheduled send was canceled.

cc.description: Copied addresses, when there were any.

created_at.description: When it was sent or queued.

error_code.description: Set when it was not delivered: why, as a code.

error_message.description: Set when it was not delivered: why, in words.

from.description: Sender, as the From header shows it.

gates.description: Set when rules refused it: which ones.

name.description: Rule that refused it, such as send_to_known_addresses.

reason.description: Why, as a code, when given.

in_reply_to_email_id.description: Set when it answers an inbound email: its id, for getEmail.

quoted_chars_removed.description: Characters of quoted history left out. Not with full.

reply_to.description: Reply-To addresses, when there were any.

request_id.description: full only: id of the send request, for support.

scheduled_at.description: When a scheduled send goes out.

smtp_response_code.description: Remote server reply code, such as 550. Compact rows leave it out once delivered.

smtp_response_text.description: Remote server reply text. Compact rows leave it out once delivered.

status.description: queued, submitted_to_agent, delivered, bounced, deferred, wait_timeout, gate_denied, agent_failed, scheduled, canceled or unknown.

tags.description: Your labels on the send, when it has any.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null when it is in none.

to.description: Recipients, as the To header shows them.

title: Get sent email
